text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the end of the year, and the Arima Kinen has arrived. T.M. Opera O, Meisho Doto, and Admire Vega all gather for the winter Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road was also selected to run in the race. She steps into the paddock with her peers amidst the roar of the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega speaks for a moment before stopping herself. Words are no longer needed. Surely they'll converse plenty on the racecourse.
